admission.justification: The parser and registered public-read regressions catch explanatory body text being mistaken for the closing pair and retain the genuine final trailer path.

applicability: Code-Commit attribution parsed from a memory commit message by the shared parser and consumed by public closed-weakness and record reads.
conditions: Only the message’s final paragraph may form the trailer block; it follows a preceding paragraph and contains only trailer or permitted continuation lines.
A matching key in the body supplies no closing attribution. A usable final trailer is passed to the reader’s full-real-code-commit check.
exclusions: A syntactically recognized trailer does not independently prove that the named code removed the weakness.
The reader can still report unavailable attribution for missing, foreign, non-commit or unreadable objects; no successful attribution is promised in those cases.

evidence: 261112-BUG-L3-W10-worker.md, repair and exact-check sections; W10-evidence.tar.gz retains the isolated predecessor/final Git comparisons and public answers.

statement: A body-only Code-Commit mention supplies no closing attribution, while a genuine final trailer remains available through both public reads.
